item.tib: gshen sde dge 'dun 'dus pa'i bslab bya'i bca' yig phan bde'i sa bon
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus nas byon pa'i 'gro mgon nam mkha' lhun grub kyi gdan sa bzhag gsar 'gro mgon dgon gsar bzhengs g.yung drung bdud 'dul gling du sdom gsum gyi 'chad nyan rgya cher bgyid skabs bla dge thun mong nas nan bskul gyi ngor khod spungs dbra ston pa bskal bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nas bris te phul//
